Every figure takes a form the case key accepts, and a terminal reply holds no Mermaid fence and no image
Every text-fence figure passes the ASCII lint

concerns.structure: who calls, owns, reads, writes or hosts whom

concerns.decision: an ordered procedure of checks and its outcomes
concerns.order: stages that wait for other stages
concerns.matrix: which member of one set may act on which member of another
